# SD18 deterministic Human Fighter level 12 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic Human Fighter pilot from the bounded
# level 11 (Armor Training 3) tranche to level 12 as chosen input only. It
# names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity values.
# It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam and the deterministic
# Longsword / Chain Shirt / no-shield posture. Level 12 grants another bonus
# feat (the cadence is 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, ...), so this fixture adds the
# choice:fighter_bonus_feat_12 selection (canonically feat:weapon_specialization,
# whose prerequisites -- fighter level 4 and Weapon Focus with the same weapon --
# the canonical loadout honestly meets via the level-1 Weapon Focus (longsword)
# bonus feat); it introduces no new armor-training or weapon-training milestone
# (Armor Training stayed at rank 3 from level 11 and Weapon Training stayed at
# rank 2 from level 9; Weapon Training 3 arrives at level 13).
